  • Cesta de Natal e Kit Congelado;
  • Brinquedos de Natal;
  • Empresa cidadã (licença maternidade e paternidade) e presente do bebê;
  • Desconto mensal em produtos AMBEV;
  • Banco de horas;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Fretado;
  • Abono anual referente a um salário.

Isso mesmo, o Hub de Tecnologia da Ambev

Somos responsáveis por impulsionar a transformação digital da Ambev. O match perfeito entre o portfólio da maior cervejaria do mundo e soluções de Data & Analytics, Cibersegurança, Infraestrutura, Suporte, Field, Engenharia e Arquitetura de Software. Contamos com cerca de 50 Squads, que atuam em mais de 100 produtos, e cada linha de código criada aqui conecta nossa paixão por tecnologia aos mais diversos brindes e suas razões.

Do campo ao copo, entregamos soluções simples e escaláveis usando tecnologia de ponta para transformar o dia a dia de milhares de pessoas. E isso só é possível graças a um time incrível que faz acontecer, com inovação, senso de dono e muito orgulho de ser tech.

PROTAGONIZAMOS SOLUÇÕES GLOBAIS

Muitas das nossas soluções são escaladas para a Ambev Global Tech, hub de tecnologia da Anheuser-Busch InBev (AB InBev), multinacional de bebidas e cervejas, e para outras unidades de negócio da companhia. Com escritórios espalhados por países como Estados Unidos, México, Índia, Argentina e Brasil, estamos conectados a uma rede global de inovação e tecnologia para transformar a Ambev em uma plataforma que conecta pessoas e o ecossistema.

NOSSO JEITO TECH DE SER

Por aqui, sonhamos grande e sabemos a importância de ter equipes cada vez mais diversas. É através da pluralidade de ideias, experiências e opiniões que conseguimos pensar fora da caixa e criar soluções inovadoras. Por isso, contamos com nosso Comitê de Autenticidade Tech para olhar com muito carinho e responsabilidade todas as questões relacionadas à inclusão.

QUER TRABALHAR COM A GENTE?

Para atuar na Ambev Tech com projetos nacionais, temos unidades em Blumenau (SC), Maringá (PR), São Paulo (SP) e Jaguariúna (SP), e contamos também com um time remoto em vários cantos do Brasil e América Latina. Para projetos internacionais, na Ambev Global Tech, a contratação acontece no modelo presencial, em Campinas (SP).

title: Executivo(a) de Vendas Externas IV
description:
Nosso modo de fazer no time


Transforme sua carreira com o iFood Somos uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia referência na América Latina. Por meio de soluções inovadoras, conectamos milhares de restaurantes a milhões de consumidores diariamente com uma média de 100 milhões de pedidos mensais. Além do delivery de comida, também somos Mercado, Farmácia e Pet. Temos também o iFood Pago, nossa Fintech, que engloba o iFood Benefícios, o vale alimentação e refeição do iFood e o próprio iFood Pago, o banco do restaurante. Junte-se a nós e faça parte de uma equipe que está sempre à frente com tecnologia de ponta e inovação constante.

Seu Cardápio Diário

  • Gestão de Carteira e Relacionamento: Gerenciar e desenvolver uma carteira de contas estratégicas, com foco na construção de relacionamento de longo prazo, confiança e atendimento consultivo, atuando como o principal ponto focal.
  • Consultoria e Venda de Ecossistema: Atuar como consultor(a) de negócios, realizando diagnósticos analíticos (baseados em dados da carteira) para identificar as necessidades dos parceiros e apresentar soluções aderentes do ecossistema de produtos e serviços (financeiros, tecnologia, totens, maquinonas, Turbo, Hits, alavancas de investimento etc.).
  • Geração de Receita e Rentabilidade (Farmer/Grower): Focar na rentabilização da carteira, buscando captação de investimento (alavancas) e venda de múltiplos produtos/serviços por parceiro (cross-sell e up-sell), com base na consultoria e no diagnóstico realizado.
  • Estratégia Competitiva e Retenção: Conduzir a captação e retenção de exclusividade dos parceiros, gerenciando a concorrência e atuando preventivamente para garantir a competitividade de ofertas e preços nas plataformas.
  • Tratativa de Grandes Marcas e Atritos: Atuar na condução de atritos e resolução de problemas de forma consultiva e eficaz com as grandes marcas da carteira, garantindo a satisfação e a continuidade do relacionamento.
  • Rotina e Organização de Campo: Manter uma rotina de campo disciplinada (presencial 3x na semana), utilizando ferramentas de CRM (Salesforce) e produtividade (Slack, Excel/Sheets) para planejar visitas, gerenciar o pipeline e reportar resultados, garantindo a organização da carteira.
  • Desenvolvimento de Mercado: Monitorar tendências e movimentos de mercado em Campinas e região para identificar novas oportunidades e adaptar as estratégias comerciais.
  • Acompanhamento e Desenvolvimento da Carteira: Monitorar e analisar KPIs da carteira (volume de vendas, ticket médio, churn, adesão a produtos) e propor planos de ação corretivos.

Ingredientes que buscamos

  • Experiência Profissional: Sólida experiência com vendas externas consultivas (B2B) e gestão de carteira de grandes contas (Farmer).
  • Autonomia e Senso de Dono: Alta maturidade para gerenciar a agenda e o território de forma independente, com foco no resultado.
  • Resiliência: Capacidade de manter o foco e a energia em um ambiente de alta cobrança e em constante mudança.
  • Negociação Complexa: Habilidade para negociar termos contratuais e financeiros (antecipações, exclusividades) com stakeholders sêniores dos parceiros.
  • Habilidades Técnicas: Conhecimento em Pacote Office, Power BI/Looker e análise de dados.

Sobre nós


No iFood, acreditamos na força da diversidade para gerar #Inovação e atingir #Resultados incríveis, por isso, não fazemos distinção para candidatos com deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar e estética. Temos grupos compostos por foodlovers voluntários, onde falamos sobre Raça, Gênero, LGBTQI+ e PcD, queremos ser a empresa onde pessoas escolham como lugar onde vão se desenvolver e contribuir para a realização de sonhos, #AllTogether.

Nós, FoodLovers, temos fome de inovação e resultado. Buscamos sempre fazer o nosso melhor, pensando "fora da caixa" e atuando com agilidade e responsabilidade Temos fome de diversidade, conhecimento e compartilhamento. title: Frontend Engineer
description:
Company Overview

BotCity is building the future of automation with the Governance Platform for Python automations and AI Agents. We empower enterprises to innovate at scale, bringing governance, control, and observability to every automation project. Our philosophy is simple: automation is software, and software deserves the same high-code standards that drive innovation in AI and machine learning.

We recently raised a $12M Series A, led by Four Rivers with participation from Y Combinator, SoftBank, and top industry leaders such as Lew Cirne (New Relic), Rod Johnson (Spring Source), and Walter Kortschak (Summit Partners | Firestreak Ventures). With 1,000+ customers in 70+ countries, including Bayer and LG, and recognition by G as one of the world's top 25 emerging platforms, BotCity is scaling fast.

We're a global remote company with teams across the US and LATAM, united by a shared vision to redefine how enterprises build and manage automation. If you're looking for an environment that values impact, autonomy, and excellence, we'd love for you to join us on this journey.

Role Overview

This Frontend Engineer will be responsible for driving the development of intuitive, high-performance user interfaces that simplify how developers manage increasingly complex frontend applications. By consistently deploying user-friendly features and maintaining a high-quality codebase, this role ensures the delivery of performant products that directly enhance user satisfaction and align with our long-term strategic growth. We are looking for a resilient and autonomous professional with a proven track record in product-focused companies, specifically one who has experience working on core product features and thrives in highly collaborative environments alongside UX and Engineering teams. This role will report to the CTO.

Responsibilities

  • Develop, deploy, and maintain scalable, responsive web applications using modern front-end technologies (focus on desktop with some mobile, which could evolve with time).
  • Collaborate with product managers and UX/UI designers to understand requirements, ensure its technical feasibility, and translate them into technical, user-friendly solutions.
  • Maintain and improve the company's front-end codebase by refactoring legacy code and implementing best practices ensuring performance across multiple devices and browsers.
  • Participate in code reviews, ensuring best practices in front-end development.
  • Identify and troubleshoot front-end issues to ensure a seamless user experience.
  • Write reusable code and libraries for future use, optimizing components for maximum speed.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related technical discipline.
  • Proven professional experience (3+ years) in front-end development, preferably in product-focused companies and working in complex projects alongside Product/UX/UI teams.
  • Proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript and TypeScript, with expertise on React
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs and working alongside back-end development teams.
  • Experience working with authentication and authorization mechanisms using OAuth, JWT, or SAML.
  • Experience with testing frameworks (e.g., Jest, Cypress) for front-end applications.
  • Experience with version control and project management systems, particularly Git and GitHub.
  • Ability to work independently as well as part of a team, with strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Experience working with modern async communication and documentation tools (e.g., Slack, Notion)
  • Ability to travel as needed to meet the team.
  • English - Advanced (Reading, Comprehension, and Writing).
  • Portuguese - Fluent

Preferred Qualifications

  • Relevant hands-on experience with desktop-first products in a tech-intensive industry, such as dashboards featuring complex data visualizations and interactive charts
  • Experience with Vite, Webpack, Babel, and other build tools for optimizing front-end workflows.
  • Experience in building responsive layouts and ensuring cross-browser compatibility.
  • Experience with SSR-capable frameworks (eg., , Remix
  • Experience with secure data storage and handling sensitive information (e.g., encryption, tokenization).
  • Experience implementing secure front-end authentication/session patterns to protect user data, including proper input sanitization, secure JWT/cookie handling, safe browser storage choices and alignment with OWASP guidance.
  • Prior experience in an early-stage, high-growth and fast-paced startup (or similar) environment.

title: Junior Account Executive
description:
Toradex is a global company strongly focused on engineering & technology. We're powered by a diverse & uniquely gifted workforce. We pursue the best people to propel our innovative vision of embedded computing and IoT. If you're interested in being a driving force at an agile technology company, engineering clever computing solutions & helping other companies bring their products to life, we should talk.

About the Role


As an Account Executive, you will be responsible for supporting and developing relationships with customers across Latin America, helping them bring their products to market faster through Toradex solutions.
You will act as the bridge between customers and our technical experts — understanding their needs, proposing high-value solutions, and ensuring the success of each project.
This position is ideal for ambitious, results-driven professionals who want to grow in a global environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Expand the customer base and increase revenue in the region by identifying new opportunities and building strategic relationships.
  • Act in a consultative manner, supporting and winning design-in projects by understanding technical needs and positioning Toradex solutions as the best choice.
  • Ensure customer success during development by overseeing technical evaluations and coordinating issue resolution with internal experts.
  • Strengthen relationships with existing customers by anticipating needs, tracking project progress, and exploring upselling and cross-selling opportunities.

Ideal Profile

  • Passion for technology and helping customers turn ideas into real products.
  • Hands-on mindset with a strong focus on problem-solving.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to clearly translate technical concepts.
  • Proactive in identifying risks and anticipating solutions.
  • Entrepreneurial spirit, initiative, and focus on high-impact results.
  • Collaborative profile, able to work in teams on complex opportunities.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written); Spanish is a plus.

Desired Technical Knowledge

  • Genuine interest in technology and curiosity to learn about technical products.
  • Good understanding of general technology concepts (processors, devices, software updates, connectivity).
  • Ability to engage with engineers and understand customers' technical needs.
  • Willingness to continuously learn about technical areas related to Toradex products.
  • General knowledge of operating systems and software development.

What We Offer

  • A global, agile, and collaborative corporate culture.
  • Access to cutting-edge technologies and direct contact with highly skilled engineers.
  • Freedom to propose ideas, shape processes, and make a real impact.
  • Flexible work model and a modern, innovative environment.
  • Concrete opportunities for personal and professional growth.
  • Meal allowance (flash card)
  • Health and dental care
  • Flexible working hours
  • Parking space
  • Anniversary day off

Toradex is a leader in embedded computing, serving innovative products to industrial, medical, automotive & IoT companies creating feature-rich & intelligent systems for demanding applications, e.g. supercars, self-driving tractors, patient monitoring systems – to name a few.

We provide effective & robust embedded computing solutions and strive for the best development experience in the industry with a focus on intelligent hardware design, innovative software solutions & free comprehensive support. Our relationship with our customers ensures that we all succeed and it allows us to participate in the realization of incredible new products. Our products are directly sold to more than 3'000 industrial customers in over 70 different countries worldwide.

title: Compliance Analyst
description:
About Marex

Marex Group plc (NASDAQ: MRX) is a diversified global financial services platform providing essential liquidity, market access and infrastructure services to clients across energy, commodities and financial markets. The group provides comprehensive breadth and depth of coverage across four core services: clearing, agency and execution, market making, and hedging and investment solutions. It has a leading franchise in many major metals, energy and agricultural products, with access to 60 exchanges. The group provides access to the world's major commodity markets, covering a broad range of clients that include some of the largest commodity producers, consumers and traders, banks, hedge funds and asset managers. With more than 40 offices worldwide, the group has over 2,300 employees across Europe, Asia and the Americas.

For more information visit

Role Summary

Marex has a growing presence in Brazil in Agricultural and Clearing activities, including the recent acquisition of Agrinvest, a relevant player in commodities physical brokerage, agricultural risk & educational consulting as well as the introduction of Brazilian and International listed derivatives.

This position will cover both Agrinvest and other Marex Brazil's activities and projects in Brazil from a Compliance perspective. The successful candidate will be required To implement, monitor, and maintain compliance policies and procedures, ensuring the company

complies with legal, regulatory, and internal standards, especially in commodity trading operations, which involve high regulatory and financial risk.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct compliance and AML risk analyses for customers, suppliers, and business partners.
  • Monitor business transactions to identify potential misappropriation, fraud, or illegal practices (e.g. money laundering, corruption).
  • Develop and review international policies, such as the Code of Conduct, Anti-Corruption Policy, and Compliance Policy.
  • Provide regulatory compliance opinions for projects and new activities/services to be developed by Agrinvest and other Marex Group companies in Brazil.
  • Participate in projects and initiatives of Agrinvest and other Marex Group companies as a Compliance representative.
  • Assist and support the development and management of the Compliance and AML Programs of Agrinvest and other Marex Group companies in Brazil.
  • Conduct periodic compliance training for employees.
  • Monitor relevant national and international legislation (e.g., Anti-Corruption Law, FCPA, UK Bribery Act, Central Bank and CVM regulations) and conduct analyses.
  • Participate in internal and external audits, providing documentary and technical support.
  • Prepare compliance reports and key performance indicators (KPIs) for the Brazilian Compliance department.
  • Ensuring compliance with the company's regulatory requirements under the Brazilian Central Banco and Brazilian Securities Commission rules.
  • Adhere to the operational risk framework for your role ensuring that all regulatory or company determined parameters are complied with.
  • Role model for demonstrating highest level standards of integrity and conduct and reflecting Company Values.
  • At all times complying with the Marex's Code of Conduct
  • To ensure that you are fully aware of and adhere to internal policies that relate to you, your role or any other activities for which you have any level of responsibility
  • To report any breaches of policy to Compliance and/ or your supervisor as required
  • To escalate risk events immediately
  • To provide input to risk management processes, as required.

Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in law, Business Administration, Economics, International Relations, or related fields.
  • Knowledge of regulatory legislation, internal controls, and corporate governance. A postgraduate degree in the field is a plus.
  • 3 to 5 years* of prior experience in commodities companies or financial institutions in similar roles (Compliance, AML, Auditing, Risk, Internal Controls, etc.). Previous experience in brokerage firms or securities dealers is a plus.
  • Advanced English (spoken and written)
  • Proficiency in risk analysis and compliance tools (e.g., World-Check, LexisNexis, SAP GRC).
  • Excellent English and Brazilian Portuguese verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience working in a regulated environment and knowledge of the risk and compliance requirements associated with this.

Competencies

  • A collaborative team player, approachable, self-efficient and influences a positive work environment
  • Demonstrates curiosity
  • Resilient in a challenging, fast-paced environment
  • Excels at building relationships, networking and influencing others
  • Strategic collaborator with insight and agility, able to anticipate future challenges, ensuring operational effectiveness

Conduct Rules

You must:

  • Act with integrity
  • Act with due skill, care and diligence
  • Be open and cooperative with the FCA, the PRA and other regulators
  • Pay due regard to the interests of customers and treat them fairly
  • Observe proper standard of market conduct
  • Act to deliver good outcomes for retail customers

Company Values

Acting as a role model for the values of the Company:

Respect - Clients are at the heart of our business, with superior execution and superb client service the foundation of the firm. We respect our clients and always treat them fairly.

Integrity
- Doing business the right way is the only way. We hold ourselves to a high ethical standard in everything we do – our clients expect this and we demand it of ourselves.

Collaborative
- We work in teams - open and direct communication and the willingness to work hard and collaboratively are the basis for effective teamwork. Working well with others is necessary for us to succeed at what we do.

Developing our People
- Our people are the basis of our competitive advantage. We look to "grow our own" and make Marex the place ambitious, hardworking, talented people choose to build their careers.

Adaptable and Nimble
- Our size and flexibility is an advantage. We are big enough to support our client's various needs, and adaptable and nimble enough to respond quickly to changing conditions or requirements. A non-bureaucratic, but well controlled environment fosters initiative as well as employee satisfaction.

Marex is fully committed to the elimination of unlawful or unfair discrimination and values the differences that a diverse workforce brings to the company.

OLÁ, SOMOS A AMBEV TECH

Do campo ao copo, entregamos soluções simples e escaláveis usando tecnologia de ponta para transformar o dia a dia de milhares de pessoas. E isso só é possível graças a um time incrível que faz acontecer, com inovação, senso de dono e muito orgulho de ser tech.

NOSSO JEITO TECH DE SER

Ensino Médio Completo;

Planejamento de metas.

Fundada em Nova Bassano, Rio Grande do Sul, a ALEA deu início as suas atividades no ano de 1990 realizando manutenção de eletrônicos. Estamos presente nos estados do Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná, Espirito Santo, Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Minas Gerais, Distrito Federal, Goiás, Bahia, Pará, Maranhão e Rondônia sendo reconhecida como a maior parceira da Vivo no Brasil.
